evidence:
Smallest submission satisfying the brief (skill quality-checks.md section 7: 'ask what the smallest submission satisfying the brief would be'). task/instruction.md:1-5 asks for a playground whose 'editor itself matters', states 'there is no starter app to finish' and delegates to six notes. Those notes make the minimum a multi-subsystem build: ui.md:3 'Build the code editing surface with your own DOM, canvas or SVG text model. Don't use a textarea, input or contenteditable element as the document surface, and don't use CodeMirror, Monaco, Ace ...'; ui.md:5-15 caret/grapheme navigation, mouse selection, multi-caret with atomic undo, find/replace, token colouring, formatter; behaviour.md:3-7 isolated run, error line numbers, five-second budget, last-good restore, Stop cancelling pending work; security.md:3-5 preview isolation and dynamic-code refusal; behaviour.md:9-13 and integration.md:7-9 SQLite persistence across restart, stale-save refusal, live library refresh, revision history and repeat-safe restore. seed_data.json has 'snippets': [] and environment/Dockerfile:17-23 leaves /app with only .gitkeep, so there is nothing to tweak. A static page, a single CRUD screen or a mock does not satisfy this ask.

Reward side. tests/tools/score.py:41-48 returns reward 0.0 unless both gates pass and functional > 0.05 (tests/scoring.toml floors). (a) no-op / empty /app: gates fail, reward 0. (b) static shell or mock: gates/render/judge.toml cw_workspace_loads_and_takes_typing 'Fails ... if the typed word does not appear in the editor', gates/render/prompt.md:5 'a static shell whose editor cannot be typed into fails'. (c) trivial textarea/contenteditable or CodeMirror CRUD screen: gates/constraints cw_custom_document_surface 'Fails if the displayed source text lives in a textarea, an input or an element with contenteditable enabled ... or ... root markers of a ready-made editor'. (d) client-only mock (localStorage): cw_shared_saved_record clears origin storage and reloads, 'Fails if the snippet is missing after browser storage was cleared'. (e) a shell that passes both gates (minimal custom surface + server save) still gets 0 unless it earns more than 2.95 of the 59.0 functional weight (43 criteria, weights summed from functional/judge.toml), i.e. at least two to three conjunctive criteria, each of which needs real editor or runtime or revision work and a positive control (functional/prompt.md:16 'A positive control must come before every negative claim'; app_context.md:30 'a criterion whose steps need a working Run fails if Run does not work'). Polish criteria likewise need working Format, Undo/Redo, Replace all, Save and an unsaved marker. The golden is a real build (custom-editor.js 1284 lines, runtime.ts 408, server.js 171, app.tsx 175) and scripted golden results on these bytes show the 3 gate, 43 functional and 6 polish checks true (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json, restart.json), so the ask is achievable but not trivially.

Notes (not defects of this row). N1: the shaped reward is not all-or-nothing. A modest app that clears the 0.05 functional floor with a handful of criteria and has a tidy layout can collect most of the 0.2 visual weight (visual/prompt.md:14 'A Run that fails is not a reason to lower a visual score') plus part of polish, roughly 0.2-0.3 total by arithmetic. That shape (0.6/0.2/0.2, floor 0.05, likert visual) is byte-identical template policy (scoring.toml, score.py and test.sh diff clean against the frozen template) and clearing the floor already needs a working custom editor and server persistence, so this is partial credit for partial real work, not a stub earning the reward. N2: the cheapest route through the constraints gate is an off-screen full-document textarea mirrored into a div ('A small input or textarea that is used only to receive keyboard or clipboard events is allowed'); it would still need its own caret and selection drawing, mouse hit-testing, multi-caret, find/replace, formatter, sandboxed runtime and revision store to score, so it is not a trivial tweak; whether the gate wording should exclude it belongs to the constraints-gate rows. N3 (the reason risk=true): no weak or stub submission has been graded on these bytes. The only hosted discrimination evidence (nop reward 0; GPT-5.6 Luna reward 0 because the render gate failed) is on an earlier candidate whose render gate still included Run; the gate has since been reduced to load-and-type, so the floor and the scored suites, not the gate, now carry stub exclusion, and that is established here by reading and arithmetic only.
